name: belsteklo-meta-ads
description: Read, audit, and safely manage BelStekloExpert Meta Ads, including externally approved PAUSED website-leads bundles, through a guarded local MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Audit Meta Ads and apply bounded, logged changes.
interface.longDescription: A local control plane for BelStekloExpert Meta Ads. It reads campaign and Insights data, hides raw asset identifiers by default, prepares deterministic change sets, applies only allow-listed pause, resume, or budget operations, and can prepare or separately materialize a tightly scoped website-leads bundle whose delivery objects remain PAUSED.
defaultPrompt: Audit Meta Ads for the last 7 complete days
Prepare a safe budget change as a dry run
Prepare a PAUSED website-leads campaign bundle as a dry run
Show Meta Ads guardrails and recent changes
